For the 16 launch heroes, 49 view slots have partial reference and 111 have no adequate dedicated view; zero of 160 slots are certified production-ready. Missing across the launch: front, side, back, isolated silhouette, consistent combat stance and expression sheet. Weapon details are missing except partial Solkael gauntlets. The three common partial slots are neutral, 3/4 front and palette.

## Source conflicts resolved for specification

- Textual identity/affinities win over erroneous branch badges in roster art. Arcane→Essence, Venom→Toxin, Frost→Ice; other invented branch names are rejected.
- Solkael uses sourced tower gauntlets, not swords from unnamed lion studies.
- The white ice-wolf sheets are not identified as Fenrox and do not add Ice affinity.
- Candidate boards change anatomy (snake legs/coil, eagle arms/full bird, panther biped/quadruped, mantis human/insect). Proposed stable morphologies are explicit in sheets; stage-driven topology changes are not approved.
- Images label evolution unlock levels, Rare/Mythic and extra branch names. None change economy, levels, rarity or the 150-card dataset.
- No source defines gender/presentation or voice. All remain unresolved, including apparently gendered names and drawings.

## Decisions required at v1.19 entry

Establish provenance/license or create independently authored original design without reusing uncleared pixels. Complete consistent minimum views; record approved morphology, dimensions, dominant hand, palm/socket orientation, tail/wing extents and facial-control mapping. Choose a licensed shipping font and original branch glyphs. These are preflight work for v1.19, not permission to begin final modeling now.

## Preserved balance signals

The v1.17 report remains authoritative: Shield/healing scenario 04 had 100% timeout; skill scenario 08 about 99%; Toxin scenario 05 averaged 6.136 s with 95/1000 draws; cross-order scenarios 11/12 about 5.999 s with 100% B wins. These are untuned fixture observations, not roster score inputs. No gameplay values change. See `docs/qa/V1_17_BALANCE_REPORT.md` for all metrics and limitations.
